visible.message: A multiselect inside @st.fragment displays empty instead of its saved default after a parent selector changes and resets state. My reduced example works, but the full app fails and the relevant parent callback is not included. Python 3.12.9 and Chrome. I have not supplied the installed Streamlit version or an earlier version comparison. Which information is useful next?
